approach: Add one pure function, `undecided_surface_changes(&SurfaceDiff, &[S]) -> Vec<String>`, and a private `DECISION_LOG` constant to crates/athena-core/src/design_surface.rs. It returns one finding line per surface kind with changes, unless the changed paths include docs/decisions.md or the diff is empty. A unit test builds two `SurfaceInventory` values directly, runs the existing `diff`, and checks the flagged and unflagged outcomes. Then fill OLY-A-12 in docs/spec.toml (mechanism naming the function, owner Athena, measure ending `status: not shown` and naming the test), add an Unreleased/Added bullet to CHANGELOG.md, and append D172 to docs/decisions.md. D172 avoids the three phrases the backtest scans and states the path rule's limit. run/checks.rs is NOT touched (round-2 finding 1). Nothing is wired into landing, admission or `athena status`.

decisions.choice: The check is a pure function over a SurfaceDiff and a list of changed paths; it does not call git.
decisions.reason: `diff` (design_surface.rs:722) already yields added, removed and changed items per kind. `SurfaceInventory` derives Default with public BTreeMap fields (crates/athena-data/src/records/design_surface.rs:12-26), so a test builds inventories without a repository. The caller supplies the paths, so later wiring is one call.

rejected.option: A function taking a Git and two commits that computes the inventories and changed paths itself
rejected.why: It repeats `inventory_at` and `diff` and needs a git fixture per case. The pure form covers the same rule and is smaller.

rejected.option: Wire it into landing or `athena status` now
rejected.why: Out of scope. Wiring adds a refusal and a status label, and no existing status line fits.

decisions.choice: A design decision means the change touches docs/decisions.md. Findings are one line per kind with changes, built from `SurfaceDiff::kinds()` (design_surface.rs:635) and `KindDiff::total()` (608). The doc comment and D172 state the limit: any edit to the log silences the check, including one that adds no entry. Follow-ups, recorded in D172: wiring, and comparing base and candidate logs for a new `## D` heading as the decision gate does (run/checks.rs:21-51).
decisions.reason: This is the reading the user accepted. It judges structure, not intent, as D162 does for the mirrors. The false negative is written down, not hidden.

rejected.option: Parse the new D-entries and require one to name the changed item
rejected.why: That judges intent, which the accepted reading did not ask for.

rejected.option: Compare base and candidate logs for a new `## D` heading now
rejected.why: The function would need both log texts, which makes it larger and moves it toward wiring (out of scope). Recorded as a follow-up.

decisions.choice: The measure is `status: not shown` and names `cargo test -p athena-core design_surface`.
decisions.reason: xtask/tests/spec.rs:190-207 requires the measure to end with `status: <label>`, and hestia accepts `not shown`. The check is not wired into anything `athena status` prints, so no label fits. This is the OLY-A-09 precedent (CHANGELOG.md:12-16).

rejected.why: It needs wiring and a status.rs change, both out of scope.

decisions.choice: Define a private `const DECISION_LOG: &str = "docs/decisions.md"` in design_surface.rs. Do not touch crates/athena-core/src/run/checks.rs. This answers round-2 finding 1: run/checks.rs is not a listed deliverable.
decisions.reason: checks.rs:7 holds a private constant of the same value in a private module (`run::checks`), and the two modules do not depend on each other. A second private constant of one path is cheaper than widening scope past the deliverables. The doc comment names checks.rs:7 as the twin so a reader can find both.

rejected.option: Make the constant public in design_surface.rs and import it into run/checks.rs (the round-2 plan)
rejected.why: It edits a file outside the deliverables, which the review flagged as widening scope.

rejected.option: Make checks.rs's constant `pub(crate)` and import it
rejected.why: It also edits checks.rs, and design_surface.rs would depend on the private run module.

Its text must not contain "superseded by", "supersedes" or "amends" in any letter case, and must not contain a literal `## D164`, `## D165` or `## D166` heading text. It refers to earlier entries only as "checked" or "follows" (for example "follows D162's structural reading").

steps: In crates/athena-core/src/design_surface.rs, add `const DECISION_LOG: &str = "docs/decisions.md";` (private, with a doc line naming run/checks.rs:7 as its twin) beside the path constants (lines 31-40). Add a module-doc bullet. After `diff` (after line 734) add `pub fn undecided_surface_changes<S: AsRef<str>>(changes: &SurfaceDiff, changed_paths: &[S]) -> Vec<String>`. It returns an empty Vec when `changes.is_empty()` or when any path, after trimming a leading `./`, equals DECISION_LOG. Otherwise it returns one line per entry of `changes.kinds()` with a non-zero `total()`, for example `commands: 1 added, 0 removed, 0 changed, with no entry in docs/decisions.md`. The doc comment says paths are repository-relative with `/` separators, and states the limit: it tests whether the log is among the changed paths, not whether it gained a new entry.

In the `tests` module of design_surface.rs (line 773), add `a_surface_change_without_a_decision_is_reported_and_one_with_it_is_not`. Build `old` and `new` `SurfaceInventory` values by inserting into the BTreeMaps: a new command, a removed crate, a changed role version. Assert (a) three findings naming commands, roles and crates when the paths are `crates/a/src/lib.rs` only, (b) an empty list when `docs/decisions.md` is added to the paths, (c) an empty list when the paths are `./docs/decisions.md`, (d) an empty list for `diff(&old, &old)` with paths that exclude the log.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core design_surface`. Temporarily make the function body return `Vec::new()`, confirm assertion (a) fails, then restore the body. Do not edit crates/athena-core/src/run/checks.rs.

In docs/spec.toml, replace the OLY-A-12 `mechanism = "none"` line with a mechanism naming `undecided_surface_changes` in crates/athena-core/src/design_surface.rs. Say it returns a finding per surface kind (commands, flags, config keys, record schemas, roles, crates) changed between two inventories when the changed paths exclude docs/decisions.md, and that it is a library check not wired into landing. Keep owner = "Athena". Replace the measure with one ending `status: not shown`, e.g. `Shown by the tests of cargo test -p athena-core design_surface: a surface change without docs/decisions.md among the changed paths is reported, and one with it, or none, is not; status: not shown`.

Append entry `## D172 · ...` after the last line of docs/decisions.md (after a blank line), in the D171 layout (lines 4944-4966): Case, Decision, Alternatives, Tradeoff, Reversal cost, Provenance. State that the check tests the path, so any edit to the log silences it. Name the follow-ups: wiring, a new-heading comparison like the decision gate's, and de-duplicating the constant with run/checks.rs:7. Provenance says what was read (design_surface.rs, run/checks.rs, the OLY-A-09 precedent, the hestia label check) and what was measured (the new test), and that no reading rule changed. Do not use "supersedes", "superseded by" or "amends" in any letter case, do not write the literal headings `## D164 ·` or `## D166`, add no [[link]], and do not edit earlier lines. Grep the new text for the three phrases (case-insensitive) before testing.

Add a bullet at the top of `### Added` under `## [Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md, in the OLY-A-09 style (lines 12-16), naming `undecided_surface_changes`, the test command, the path-rule limit, and that the measure stays `status: not shown`. It must not contain "3 of the 3 cited jobs", "20261017-173508-0wtc by no check", or the names `reading::check_defined_terms`, `reading::check_history_fixture`, `reading::check_scope_limit`.

Run `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --locked`, and by name `cargo test -p athena-cli --test backtest`, `cargo test -p athena-cli --test mirrors`, `cargo test -p athena-cli decisions`, `cargo test -p athena-core --lib reading`, `cargo test -p athena-core --test refusal_corpus` and `cargo test -p xtask --test spec`.
